summary: Play together, buy Gold, deliver rewards, download worlds and recover a match.
scope: A first-party teaching demo from Velrino. Flows are illustrative architecture, not live game traffic or an exact production inventory.
author: Thoth

componentNotes.gateway: Routes authenticated requests and live game traffic to the relevant service.
componentNotes.room: Owns authoritative match state and sends snapshots to players.
componentNotes.checkpoints: Keeps recoverable room and reward state beyond the live session.
componentNotes.provider: RevenueCat connects Unity purchases to the native stores and reports purchase events to the backend.
componentNotes.jobs: Buffers work for retryable delivery to Go workers.
componentNotes.wallet: Stores the durable Gold balance and prevents duplicate grants.
componentNotes.ranking-api: Serves the public top nine per role. On a cache miss, it queries the MongoDB projection and refills the short-lived Redis snapshot.
componentNotes.ranking-db: Keeps the durable group ranking projection used to populate the public cache.
componentNotes.cdn: Serves immutable world bundles near players and uses the private origin on misses.
